name: Family Violence Screening
description: Initial screening for indicators of domestic and family violence.

name: Coercive Control Assessment
description: Assesses patterns of coercive, controlling, or dominating behaviour.

name: Victim Safety Assessment
description: Evaluates immediate and ongoing safety risks for victim-survivors.

name: Perpetrator Behaviour Assessment
description: Assesses harmful behaviours, accountability, and risk of further violence.

name: Risk Escalation Assessment
description: Identifies increasing risk factors and signs of escalating violence.

name: Child Exposure to Violence Assessment
description: Assesses the extent and impact of children's exposure to DFV.

name: Post-Separation Abuse Assessment
description: Assesses ongoing abuse after separation, including stalking and coercion.

name: Technology-Facilitated Abuse Assessment
description: Assesses digital harassment, surveillance, and technology-based abuse.

name: Stalking Assessment
description: Evaluates stalking behaviours, patterns, and associated risks.

name: Financial Abuse Assessment
description: Assesses financial control, exploitation, and economic dependency.

name: Emotional Abuse Assessment
description: Assesses emotional manipulation, intimidation, and psychological harm.

name: Safety Planning Assessment
description: Evaluates safety needs and readiness for safety planning.
